parameters: query cameras at fixed evaluator only
runtime_only.meaning: Can change with legal arrived observations under frozen support rule. This does not authorize query conditioning of scene construction.

architecture_coupled.meaning: Fixed representation/sampling budget and typed tensor topology. Some grid/token changes happen to fit the same learned matrix dimensions but still alter declared state architecture, compute, and experiment definition; forbidden for same-architecture diagnostic.

training_distribution_coupled.meaning: Representable at runtime with compatible shapes, but learned projections/convolutions were trained with a specific spatial/exposure distribution. Frozen-carrier results are out-of-distribution DIAGNOSTIC ONLY; a promising deployable redesign requires matched retraining before a fair method conclusion.

_bounds.purpose: Metric support for typed state and fixed renderer. Must match declared bounds.

_candidate_ids.purpose: Unique flattened D,H,W cell IDs; determines scatter and gather location in dense feature volume.

_candidate_points.purpose: Actual metric lifting points corresponding EXACTLY to the same IDs cell centers; moving points without scatter-location change is not a coherent oracle.

_candidate_normalized_xyz.purpose: 2*cell_center_fraction-1, used in per-candidate observed feature statistics. Must be rebuilt with IDs.

consistency_equations: scatter and gather must use the exact same ordered IDs as feature lifting

checkpoint_loading.strict_loader_checks: checkpoint.py reconstructs original deterministic evenly spaced IDs and validates all four geometry buffers against CarrierConfig before state_dict loading.
checkpoint_loading.bounds_change: Construct diagnostic geometry coherently; never copy old geometric buffers over a carrier whose config says different bounds.
checkpoint_loading.allocation_change: Arbitrary selected IDs cannot roundtrip under current mcss.dynamic.v1 loader. Do not loosen old loader or pretend modified geometry is the old B-final. Use a separately declared runtime diagnostic adapter/manifest; redesigned saved carrier requires a schema representing its allocation contract.
checkpoint_loading.learned_parameters: All carrier learned tensors, including frozen CNN, projections, refinement and typed heads, must remain byte-identical in oracle diagnostics.

oracle_preseal_exception.required_by_user_section: 4.1 explicitly authorizes primary query GT surfaces for offline oracle bounds; 26.12 says query GT only after seal. The former is a necessary narrow exception for oracle construction.
oracle_preseal_exception.allowed_inputs: Predeclared context/query camera and metric GT depth solely for oracle geometry selection; no task prediction/loss/ranking selection.
oracle_preseal_exception.required_log: Separate oracle_geometry_preseal_GT_access events before state seal. Do not report SEALED_QUERY_LEAKAGE=false as if oracle were deployable.
oracle_preseal_exception.deployable_rule: R0/R1/R2/R3 and their combinations may use only arrived RGB/cameras/frozen features plus TRAIN-frozen global constants; query GT permitted only post-state-seal evaluation.
oracle_preseal_exception.test12_scope: Strict postseal query GT test applies to all deployable paths; a separate test verifies whitelist-scoped oracle exception and final-holdout denial.

fixed_budget_oracle_design_recommendatio.volume: Use one deterministic scene-level query-GT AABB with a frozen numerical padding/minimum extent; same bounds for A/B/anchor to isolate context contribution. Report center, extent, voxel sizes, physical volume and surface-inside fraction. Same 512 cells does not mean unchanged metric resolution/physical support.
fixed_budget_oracle_design_recommendatio.candidate_pool: All 512 legal cell centers of the chosen volume. Rank using a locked depth-consistent context support/surface-distance rule with deterministic ID ties, select 128 unique IDs; never insert arbitrary off-grid points that scatter elsewhere.
fixed_budget_oracle_design_recommendatio.same_context_geometry: Prefer a scene-shared oracle geometry computed once with explicitly logged labels and applied equally to A/B/anchor. If allocation differs by context, name and report that extra factor; do not hide it in full-versus-anchor.
fixed_budget_oracle_design_recommendatio.scarcity: If fewer than128 eligible centers exist, retain candidate count by locked geometry-only fallback, report useful counts and padded unsupported counts; never claim all128 supported.
fixed_budget_oracle_design_recommendatio.surface_visibility: At-least-two frusta is not occlusion visibility. Report separate depth-consistency test and neighborhood distance with fixed tolerance/radius.
fixed_budget_oracle_design_recommendatio.wrong_scene: Keep target query camera unchanged. Wrong-scene state brings its donor bounds/geometry; log both since changing geometry as well as content broadens the attribution.
fixed_budget_oracle_design_recommendatio.retraining: Promising shape-compatible support changes still alter training distribution. Matched same3-scene/current-versus-redesign, same seeds/steps/loss/optimizer/selection is needed; keep source-black ai003.
fixed_budget_oracle_design_recommendatio.negative_result_limit: If combined oracle still fails to supply adequate actual surface/two-view support at fixed8^3/128, failure cannot establish ideal-support impossibility. Mark tested intervention insufficient or INCONCLUSIVE, not all-support mechanisms disproved.

frozen_for_this_task: old carrier and trained residual checkpoint

declared_oracle_implementation_review.candidate_pool: 512 legal voxel centers, 128 unique IDs, points/normalized/IDs/bounds synchronized
declared_oracle_implementation_review.volume_rule: Query GT surface AABB, minimum metric extent1m and fixed5%padding; log volume and voxel resolution changes
declared_oracle_implementation_review.allocation_rule: Per-context ordering: >=2-frustum eligibility, nearest observed GT surface distance, viewcount/ID deterministic tie-break
declared_oracle_implementation_review.per_context_allocation_limit: Allocation varies with context and its observed GT. Full-context-vs-anchor therefore tests context plus its oracle-dependent geometry, not isolated context evidence under shared fixed geometry; this must be explicit. It remains allowed as the requested oracle candidate-support diagnostic.
declared_oracle_implementation_review.adequacy_rule_pre_model: Combined >=2-view fraction mean>=0.9 AND query-GT neighborhood support>=0.75 AND inside fraction>=0.999, frozen before model scores. Record both macro and per-scene/context adequacy to avoid hiding weak subsets.
declared_oracle_implementation_review.failed_adequacy_interpretation: INCONCLUSIVE_SUPPORT_NOT_FULLY_REPAIRED; stop rather than expand geometry search. No ideal-support impossibility or universal representation incapability claim.
declared_oracle_implementation_review.adequate_but_failed_task_interpretation: Tested fixed8^3/128 frozen trained representation fails even this adequate intervention; training-distribution mismatch and representation remain entangled.
declared_oracle_implementation_review.holdout: Never apply this oracle to FINAL_HOLDOUT.
